column1: # The wiring. event, matcher (regex on tool_name, * = all), hook, timeout s, override verb, Bash prefilter.
# Prefilter (optional, speed only: each process costs ~150 ms on the phone): on a Bash call the hook is
# skipped unless the raw event matches this regex. It must cover everything the hook looks for.
# Verb: - = log-only (never blocks); ! = no override for the agent (operator uses a ! line or gate off).
# Rows run in this order; session-log sits last in PreToolUse so only calls that go ahead are logged,
# task-gate last of the blockers so it ticks a requirement only for a call that will run.
